desc:
🏆 IT'S TIME FOR THE WORLD CUP! ⚽

Build your dream squad and collect over 700 players from 2002 to today. Open packs, discover football legends and modern stars, and create the ultimate team.

🌟 FEATURES
• 700+ players to collect
• Players from multiple eras
• Rare and special edition cards
• Lobby plaza to show off your collection
• Best card flex displayed above your head
• Pack opening and team-building experience
• Frequent updates and new content

⚽ From legendary icons to today's superstars, YOUR favorite players are waiting to join YOUR team.

🔥 A unique football/soccer collecting experience on ROBLOX.

👍 Like, Favorite, and Join the Group for exclusive rewards, future updates, and special bonuses!

🚧 THIS GAME IS IN EARLY BETA 🚧

New players, features, and content are constantly being added. Thank you for playing and supporting the game!
